note: Results of folding each published corpus through the implementation, recorded with the SHA-256 of the file that was read. scripts/conformance-run.py uses a row only when that digest still matches the corpus on disk, so a regenerated or upgraded corpus invalidates the record rather than silently keeping a stale pass. Regenerate with scripts/conformance-execute.sh.

runs.note: A row carries a bitset naming which paragraph directions it asserts, so 490846 rows expand to 770241 cases. Rows are reported in the suite table because that is the unit the other suites count; the case figure is the one the file actually asserts.
